note: Official requirements checked October 14, 2026. School supplements are counted separately from the Common App personal essay. Optional or program-specific submissions are identified. Recheck prompts in the actual application before submitting.

carnegie-mellon.prompts: Three short-answer questions in the Common App Writing Supplement. Exact current wording and word limits must be checked in the Common App; the public requirements page verifies the count.
carnegie-mellon.special: CFA portfolio/audition/pre-screen for Architecture, Art, Design, Drama, Music; Drama/Music RD Dec 1

purdue.supp_essay_count: 2 required (+ conditional alternate-major response; Honors adds4)
purdue.prompts: How Purdue opportunities support your interests in and out of the classroom (≤250 words); reasons for your chosen major and chosen campus, Indianapolis or West Lafayette (≤250 words). An alternate major adds another conditional250-word response. Honors applicants answer four additional prompts, each≤200 words.
purdue.special: Honors College adds four essays; submit complete application by Nov 1. SAT, ACT or CLT scores expected; exceptional cases may submit without scores.

rpi.prompts: B.S./M.D.: reasons for pursuing medicine. Architecture: why architecture. Electronic Arts/GSAS/Music: interests, goals, and portfolio.
rpi.teacher_recs: 1 letter from a counselor OR teacher (preferably math/science)
rpi.counselor_rec: May satisfy the single letter requirement; separate counselor recommendation not specified
rpi.interview: Not offered domestically (InitialView for intl; optional GLIMPSE video)
rpi.fee: $70; waived for applications submitted by Dec 1 and for Rensselaer Medalists (per current apply page)
rpi.special: Architecture portfolio required; GSAS/Electronic Arts/Music portfolios; optional 60-90s GLIMPSE video

georgia-tech.interview: Not offered (international applicants may send a recorded third-party interview)
georgia-tech.special: Program portfolios may be required/optional; language-proficiency interview for international applicants

michigan.prompts: Contributing to U-M’s leaders and citizens who challenge the present and enrich the future (100–300 words); unique qualities of your college/school and how its curriculum supports your interests (100–550 words).
michigan.special: Portfolio/artistic profile for SMTD, Stamps, Taubman

maryland.supp_essay_count: Common App personal essay plus required UMD short answers; exact current portal prompts must be checked
maryland.prompts: Do not use the academic-experiences transfer prompt for a first-year application. Verify the first-year short-answer prompts in the Common App / ApplyWeb portal.
maryland.special: Activities/awards list or resume required; School of Music supplement + audition

northeastern.special: CAMD creative portfolio encouraged (one only); Performing Arts NYC audition

ohio-state.prompts: Morrill Scholarship applicants answer the MSP prompt.
ohio-state.special: Dance/music auditions and portfolios; Eminence Application; MSP essay

nc-state.platform: Common App or Coalition on Scoir
nc-state.supp_essay_count: 1 required program-interest response (+ optional Honors application essay)
nc-state.prompts: Explain why you selected the academic program(s) and why you want to study them at NC State; Honors applicants answer the separate prompt, maximum 600 words.
nc-state.counselor_rec: No — counselor endorsements dropped as of fall 2022
nc-state.interview: Not offered generally (Design/some depts interview by invitation)
nc-state.special: Honors application due Nov 1. EA application complete and NC residency through RDS confirmed by Nov 10 for end-of-December NC notification.

duke.prompts: Two required 250-word responses: Why Duke and Communities. One optional 250-word response from Viewpoints and experiences, Difference of opinion, or Something you are excited about.
duke.special: Pratt requires at least one recommendation from a math or science teacher. Test-optional for 2026-27. Robertson scholarship has a separate selection/application process; confirm its current deadline with the program.

rose-hulman.supp_essay_count: Unknown for current cycle; historical checklist states no separate supplemental prompt
rose-hulman.teacher_recs: Historical: one teacher/counselor/principal recommendation; confirm current requirement
rose-hulman.counselor_rec: Historical checklist says no separate counselor recommendation; confirm current requirement
rose-hulman.interview: Historically optional Glimpse video for domestic U.S. students and InitialView for students abroad; no-penalty rules require current confirmation.
rose-hulman.special: Historical optional 60–90 second Glimpse video. Confirm current application fields, recommendations and fee before submission.
